messages:
Ana: Quick follow-up from Friday's DR sim exercise — created a condensed remediation list and want owners + timelines. Key patterns: DNS TTLs + control-plane routing tests flaked, and backup restore steps were slower than expected.

Devon: Saw that. I captured the trace where primary->secondary routing fell back to global LB because of health-check mismatch. Link: https://redwood.internal/ci/trace/4521

Mike: Re: backups — snapshot restore to staging took ~42m versus expected <20m. Need to isolate slow snapshot transfer vs. restore time.

Sophia: Noted recurring pattern: after weekly infra maintenance we see higher latency in cross-region KV fetches for ~30m. Might be cache warm-up + deployment ordering.

Ana: Agree. Proposed breakdown of action items (short form):
- A1: Update regional restore runbook with parallel snapshot fetch step + estimated duration. owner: Ana. due: 2026-04-01.
- A2: Add DNS failover checklist (verify TTLs, pre-warm alternate routes, fallback mapping). owner: Devon. due: 2026-03-29.
- A3: Measure snapshot transfer vs. apply time, add perf counters to restore job. owner: Mike. due: 2026-03-31.
- A4: Investigate KV cache warming; propose autosize or pre-warm hook for sim runs. owner: Sophia. due: 2026-04-05.
- A5: Add a small post-sim smoke test to the game-day runbook (traffic spike + end-to-end check). owner: infra-bot (schedule). due: 2026-03-27.

Devon: For A2, I'll also add a quick DNS TTL table per region and a `dig` command snippet to validate: `dig +short @8.8.8.8 myapp.redwood.global A` — will include expected TTLs.

Mike: For A3, I'll instrument two timers in restore: `snapshot_receive_ms` and `apply_ms`. Will push a PR with metrics and dashboards.

Sophia: For pre-warm hook idea: run a lightweight read-only traffic replay against the new region before failover. I'll draft a playbook and attach a checklist of keys to warm.

Ana: Two governance notes: 1) owners should add the item to the 'incidents' Trello board and tag priority (P1/P2). 2) We'll re-run a reduced sim (control-plane + restore) in 2 weeks to validate fixes.

Devon: One more: add an automatic rollback clause in the runbook if restore > 90m, plus an alert to oncall. owner: Devon. due: 2026-03-29.

infra-bot: Scheduled: runbook-test (reduced-sim) created for 2026-04-09 18:00 UTC — invite list: Ana, Devon, Mike, Sophia.

Ana: Thanks — I'll update the runbook PR and ping owners on Monday to confirm timelines. If anyone needs help splitting tasks, @Ana is available. :thumbsup:

Mike: Quick question — should we version the restore runbook per-region (us-west/us-east/eu) or keep a unified doc with region sections?

Sophia: Leaning unified doc with region-specific toggles (less duplication). I'll sketch a template.

Devon: Agreed. We'll hold a 20-min sync Monday to finalize owners and sign-offs.

Ana: Cool. Sync invite: Mon 09:15am PT. Closing thread here — will update Trello and the runbook PRs.
